name: High-Latency & Timeout Remediation
description: Structured YAML runbook for upstream timeouts and high-latency errors.
content:
runbook: checkout-timeout
matches:
  service: checkout-api
steps:
  - check: "Is {{service}} upstream gateway healthy?"
    action: http_get
    url: "http://{{service}}.internal/health"
    approval: none
  - check: "Retry failed order {{metadata.order_id}}"
    action: retry_workflow
    workflowId: "{{metadata.order_id}}"
    approval: none
  - if: "latency still above {{metadata.latency_ms}}ms after retry"
    check: "Restart {{service}} pool and escalate to payments-oncall"
    action: escalate
    team: counterparty-support
    approval: required

name: Auth & Database Failure Playbook
description: Markdown playbook for DB connection timeouts and auth anomalies.
content:
# Incident Response: {{service}}

1. Inspect active connections and error rate on {{service}} dashboard.
2. Run a non-destructive health probe against {{service}} dependencies.
3. Fail traffic over to secondary DB replica (needs approval from team lead).
4. Post an incident update in #ops-incidents every 15 minutes until resolved.

name: Inventory Sync Recovery Notes
description: Free-text operational note copied from team wiki.
content: When {{service}} reports low stock for SKU {{metadata.sku}} (remaining: {{metadata.remaining}}), verify the warehouse feed is not stalled. Restart the {{service}} worker if stale, wait 2 minutes, and escalate to ops-inventory if stock stays below threshold.
